correctness.parameter_threshold_rationale: AdamW normalizes first-step gradients by sqrt(v)+eps; near-zero gradients can amplify sub-1e-8 gradient differences into parameter differences. The 5e-5 parameter gate remains paired with much tighter independent loss, gradient, and optimizer-state gates.
